40016202.author: पदार्थः
40016202.content: अकम्पनः Akampana, युधि in battle, वानरसत्तमैः foremost of Vanaras, कृतम् accomplishment, तत् that, सुमहत् great, कर्म action, दृष्टवा observing, तीव्रम् violent, क्रोधम् angry, आहारयामास exhibiting.

40016202.author: Translation
40016202.content: Observing the great action and accomplishment of the foremost Vanaras in the battle, Akampana exhibited violent anger.

40016203.author: पदार्थः
40016203.content: शत्रूणाम् by enemies, कर्म deeds, दृष्टवा looking, क्रोधमूर्चितरूपः exhibited violent anger, परमकार्मुकम् highly furious, धून्वन् bow, सारथिम् charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40016203.author: Translation
40016203.content: Looking at the deeds of enemies, deluded with violent anger, Akampana spoke these words holding the bow and looking at the charioteer.

40016204.author: पदार्थः
40016204.content: सारथे O Charioteer, यत्र there, बहव: many, एते those, रणे in battle, सुबहून् many, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, घ्नन्ति destroyed, त्वरितः quickly, तत्त्रैव to that place, रथम् chariot, प्रापय drive.

40016204.author: Translation
40016204.content: "O Charioteer, quickly drive the chariot to that place where many Rakshasas are destroyed in the battle."

40016205.author: पदार्थः
40016205.content: बलवन्तः mighty, भीमकोपाश्च terribly angry, एते those, वानराः Vanara, द्रुमशैलप्रहरणाः using trees and hillocks as weapons, अत्र there, मम my, प्रमुखे chiefs, तिष्ठन्तिहि stand.

40016205.author: Translation
40016205.content: "Those Vanaras are mighty and terribly angry. They are using trees and hillocks as weapons. Take me where chiefs are standing."

40016206.author: पदार्थः
40016206.content: अहम् I, समरश्लाघिनः boast of their warfare, एतान् them, निहन्तुम् will finish, इच्छामि desire to, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, एतैः in the same way, प्रमथिम् end, दृश्यते wish to see.

40016206.author: Translation
40016206.content: "I wish to see the end of Vanaras who boast of their warfare. The entire Rakshasa army is destroyed by them."

40016207.author: पदार्थः
40016207.content: ततः then, रथिनाम् on the chariot, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रचलिताश्वेन by fast moving horses, रथेन from chariot, शरजालैः network of arrows, त्क्रोधात् enraged, हरीन् Vanaras, अभ्यहनत् assailed.

40016207.author: Translation
40016207.content: Then Akampana seated in the chariot drawn by fast moving horses, assailed the Vanaras with a network of arrows.

40016208.author: पदार्थः
40016208.content: वानराः Vanaras, आहवे counter, स्थातुम् to stand, नशेकुः not fight, योद्धुम् in battle, किंपुनः What to say again, सर्वेएव all, अकम्पनशरैः by Akampana's arrows, भग्नाः shattered, विदुद्रुवुः took to their heels.

40016208.author: Translation
40016208.content: The Vanaras could not counter or stand nor fight in battle. What to say more? Shattered by Akampana's arrows, they all took to their heels.

40016209.author: पदार्थः
40016209.content: अकम्पनवंशगतान् kith and kin fallen under the sway of Akampana, मृत्युवशम् sway of death, आपन्नान् caught by, तान् them, ज्ञातीन् kin, समीक्ष्य observing, महाबलः mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, उपतस्थे approached.

40016209.author: Translation
40016209.content: Having observed that Vanaras are fallen under the sway of Akampana and under the sway of death, mighty Hanuman approached Akampana.

40016210.author: पदार्थः
40016210.content: वीराः hero, ते you, सर्वे all, प्लवगयूतपा: troops of Vanaras, महाप्लवगम् great monkey, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, समेत्य together, सहिताः along with, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

40016210.author: Translation
40016210.content: Seeing the great monkey, the Vanara troops got together and surrounded him.

40016211.author: पदार्थः
40016211.content: ते to you, हरियूथपा: monkey leaders, अवस्थितम् firmly established, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, बलवन्तम् strong, समाश्रिताः taken shelter, बभूवुः became.

40016211.author: Translation
40016211.content: Seeing Hanuman, the monkey leaders took their shelter under him, got established firmly and became strong.

40016212.author: पदार्थः
40016212.content: अकम्पनस्तु Akampana also, अवस्थितम् established, शैलाभम् like a mountain, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, धाराभिः torrents, महेन्द्रःइव like Indra, शरैः arrows, अभिनवर्षह showered rain.

40016212.author: Translation
40016212.content: On Akampana, who was well established like a mountain, mighty Hanuman showered torrents of arrows like Indra showered rain.

40016213.author: पदार्थः
40016213.content: महाबलः mighty, शितान् pierced, शरीरे in the body, पतितान् fallen, बाणौघान् volley of arrows, अचिन्तयित्वा un mindful, अकम्पनवधार्थाय for destroying Akampana, मनः mind, दध्रे thought.

40016213.author: Translation
40016213.content: Mighty Hanuman unmindful of the volley of arrows pierced in his body thought in his mind only about the destruction of Akampana.

40016214.author: पदार्थः
40016214.content: महातेजाः highly energetic, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, सः he, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रहस्य laughing, मेदिनीम् earth, कम्पयन्निव to shake, तत् रक्षः to that Rakshasa, अभिदुद्राव sprung up.

40016214.author: Translation
40016214.content: Hanuman, the highly energetic son of Maruthi laughing, sprung up causing the earth to shake and rushed to that Rakshasa.

40016215.author: पदार्थः
40016215.content: अभि super, नर्दमानस्य as he roared, तेजसा brilliance, दीप्यमानस्य blazing, तस्य his, रूपम् form, दीप्तस्य burning, विभावसोःइव like, दुर्धर्षम् formidable to win, बभूव became.

40016215.author: Translation
40016215.content: As he roared, his brilliance was blazing, his form was burning and became formidable for others to be at him.

40016216.author: पदार्थः
40016216.content: हरिपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, आत्मानम् himself, अप्रहरणम् without any weapon, ज्ञात्वा knowing, क्रोधसमन्वितः full of anger, वेगेन quickly, शैलम् mountain, उत्पाटयामास took up.

40016216.author: Translation
40016216.content: Vanara leader himself knowing that he is without any weapon, full of anger took up a mountain quickly.

40016217.author: पदार्थः
40016217.content: सः he, वीर्यवान् heroic, मारुतिः Maruthi, एकेन alone, पाणिना by hand, सुमहाशैलम् huge mountain, गृहीत्वा taking hold, महानादम् loud noise, विनद्य whirled, भ्रामयामास round.

40016217.author: Translation
40016217.content: He, the heroic Maruthi, with one hand alone taking a huge mountain whirled round making loud noises.

40016218.author: पदार्थः
40016218.content: ततः then, पुरा earlier, पुरन्दरः Indra, सङ् ख्ये rushed, वज्रेण with thunderbolt, नमुचिमिव like Namuchi, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, तम् him, अकम्पनम् Akampanam, अभिदुद्राव tormented.

40016218.author: Translation
40016218.content: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.

40016219.author: पदार्थः
40016219.content: अकम्पनस्तु Akampana too, समुद्यतम् uplifted, तत् that, गिरिशृङ्गम् peak of mountain, दृष्टवा seeing, दूरादेव from distance, अर्धचन्द्रैः halfmoon, महाबाणैः great arrows, व्यदारयत् discharged.

40016219.author: Translation
40016219.content: Seeing the peak of the mountain uplifted, Akampana also discharged halfmoon shaped great arrows from a distance.

40016220.author: पदार्थः
40016220.content: आकाशे in the sky, रक्षोबाणविदारितम् by Rakshasa's arrows broken, विकीर्णम् into pieces, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, पर्वताग्रम् peak of mountain, दृष्टवा gazing, हनुमान् Hanuman, क्रोधमूर्छितः deluded with anger.

40016220.author: Translation
40016220.content: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.

40016221.author: पदार्थः
40016221.content: सः he, हरिः monkey, रोषदर्पान्वितः pride and anger, महागिरिमिव like a big mountain, उच्छ्रितम् collecting, अश्वकर्णम् Aswakarana tree, समासाद्य holding, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्पाटयामास uprooted.

40016221.author: Translation
40016221.content: He (Hanuman) filled with pride and anger quickly uprooted an Aswakarana tree as huge as a mountain and held it.

40016222.author: पदार्थः
40016222.content: महाद्युतिः endowed with great splendour, सः he, महास्कन्धम् with huge trunk, अश्वकर्णम् Aswakarana tree, गृहीत्वा seizing, परया great, प्रीत्या with delight, प्रहस्य laughing, भूतले on the ground, भ्रामयामास whirled it round.

40016222.author: Translation
40016222.content: He (Hanuman) endowed with great splendour, seizing a huge trunk of Aswakarana tree with great delight, whirled it round on the ground laughing.

40016223.author: पदार्थः
40016223.content: परमक्रुद्धः highly enraged, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रधावन् running, ऊरुवेगेन at high speed, चरणैः feet, तरसा earth, द्रुमान् trees, प्रभञ्ज breaking, दारयत्क्षितम् cleaving the earth.

40016223.author: Translation
40016223.content: Highly enraged Hanuman was running at high speed that his feet were seen breaking the trees and cleaving the earth.

40016224.author: पदार्थः
40016224.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, सगजारोहान् the mahouts, गजांश्च and elephants, तथा similarly, सरथान् the chariots, रथिनः and riders, भीमान् terrific, पदातिगान् on foot, राक्षसान् च with Rakshasas, जघान struck.

40016224.author: Translation
40016224.content: Hanuman struck the mahouts, elephants, similarly the chariots and riders of chariots as well as the terrific Rakshasas who fought standing on feet.

40016225.author: पदार्थः
40016225.content: क्रुद्धम् angry, अन्तकमिव like spirit of death, सद्रुमम् those trees, प्राणहारिणम् took life, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, अभिप्रेक्ष्य seeing, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विप्रदुद्रुवुः took to heels.

40016225.author: Translation
40016225.content: Hanuman, enraged like the spirit of death, took their life (Rakshasas) armed with trees and on seeing him the Rakshasas took to their heels.

40016226.author: पदार्थः
40016226.content: अपतन्तम् coming towards, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहम् fearing, सङ्कृद्धम् very angry, तम् him, वीरः heroic, अकम्पनः Akampana, ददर्श saw, चुक्षोधच running, ननादच roared.

40016226.author: Translation
40016226.content: The heroic Akampana saw Hanuman coming towards him very angry. Fearing Hanuman, the Rakshasas ran roaring in fear.

40016227.author: पदार्थः
40016227.content: सःअकम्पनः Akampana, निशितैः pointed, देहविदारणैः tormenting the body, चतुर्दशभि fourteen, बाणैः arrows, महावीर्यम् powerful, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, निर्बिभेद split.

40016227.author: Translation
40016227.content: With fourteen pointed powerful arrows, Akampana tormented and split the body of Hanuman.

40016228.author: पदार्थः
40016228.content: शरवृष्टिभिः rain of arrows, बह्वीभिः many times, तदा then, प्रतिविद्दस्तु interrupted, वीरः valiant one, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, प्ररूढः stood still, सानुमानिव like a mountain with trees, ददृशे seemed.

40016228.author: Translation
40016228.content: Valiant Hanuman, even though interrupted several times with rain of arrows, stood still like a mountain full of trees.

40016229.author: पदार्थः
40016229.content: महावीर्यः exceedingly valiant, महाकायः gigantic, महामना: courageous, पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशः like fully blossomed Ashoka trees, विधूमः smokeless, पावकःइव like fire, विरराज shone.

40016229.author: Translation
40016229.content: The gigantic Hanuman, exceedingly valiant and courageous one shone like a fully blossomed Ashoka tree, resembled smokeless fire.

40016230.author: पदार्थः
40016230.content: ततः then, अनुत्तमम् supreme, वेगम् speed, कृत्वा doing, अन्यम् other, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाट्य uprooting, आशु there upon, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa chief, अकम्पनम् Akampana, शिरसि head, जघान struck.

40016230.author: Translation
40016230.content: Then Hanuman performed another supreme deed by uprooting a tree and striking on the head of Akampana, the chief of Rakshasas.

40016231.author: पदार्थः
40016231.content: सक्रोधेन reacting in anger, महात्मना great self, तेनवानरेन्द्रेण by Vanara chief, वृक्षेण by the tree, हतः striking, सः he, राक्षसः Rakshasa, पपात fell, ममारच dead.

40016231.author: Translation
40016231.content: Reacting in anger the great Vanara chief struck the Rakshasa with a tree, by which the Rakshasa fell down dead.

40016232.author: पदार्थः
40016232.content: निहतम् dead, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa chief, तम् him, अकम्पनम् Akampana, भूमौ on the ground, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, क्षितिकम्पे shaken in earthquake, द्रुमाःइव like a tree, व्यथिताः distressed.

40016232.author: Translation
40016232.content: Seeing Akampana lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas were shaken like the trees in the earthquake and were distressed.

40016233.author: पदार्थः
40016233.content: पराजिताः defeated, ते they, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः abandoning weapons, तैः those, वानरा: Vanaras, अभिद्रुताः chased, त्रस्ता: frightened, लङ्काम् into Lanka, अभियुयुः ran away.

40016233.author: Translation
40016233.content: Abandoning weapons, all Rakshasas having been defeated, chased by the Vanaras, frightened, ran away into Lanka.

40016234.author: पदार्थः
40016234.content: सम्भ्रान्ता perplexed, भग्नमाना broken hearted, पराजिताः defeated, मुक्तकेशाः hair loosened, ते they, स्रवच्छ्रमजलैः sweating in limbs, अङ्गैः limbs, श्वसन्तः sighing heavily, विप्रदुद्रुवुः ran very fast.

40016234.author: Translation
40016234.content: Perplexed, broken hearted, defeated, hair loosened the Rakshasas sweating all over their limbs, sighing heavily ran away very fast.

40016235.author: पदार्थः
40016235.content: ते they, भयात् in fear, पृष्ठतः covertly, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, प्रेक्षमाणाः looking back, सम्मूढाः bewildered, अन्योन्यम् one another, प्रममन्थु: crushing, नगरम् city, विविशुः went.

40016235.author: Translation
40016235.content: Again, and again looking back in fear, covertly, bewildered, crushing one another, they went into the Lanka city.

40016236.author: पदार्थः
40016236.content: तेषुराक्षसेषु those Rakshasas, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविष्टेषु on entering, सर्वे all, महाबलाः endowed with prowess, हरयः Vanaras, समेत्य getting together, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अपूजयन् paid respects.

40016236.author: Translation
40016236.content: Those Rakshasas, endowed with prowess, on entering Lanka got together and paid respects to Hanuman.

40016237.author: पदार्थः
40016237.content: सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with goodness, सः he, हनुमानपि Hanuman also, अनुकूलतः others for their part, यथार्हम् accordingly, तान् them, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, सम्प्रत्यपूजयत् greatly honoured.

40016237.author: Translation
40016237.content: Hanuman also who was richly endowed with goodness greatly honoured all the Vanaras accordingly.

40016238.author: पदार्थः
40016238.content: जितकाशिनः atmosphere of triumph, हरयः monkeys, यथाप्राणम् their life, विनेदुः sportively, तत्र there, सप्राणानपि willing to give up their life, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, पुनः again, चकर्षुश्च shouted.

40016238.author: Translation
40016238.content: In an atmosphere of triumph, the monkeys sportively shouted again saying that they are willing to give up their life also.

40016239.author: पदार्थः
40016239.content: महाकपिः great Vanara, सःमारुतिः that Maruti, चमूमुखे in front army, रक्षांसि saviour, समेत्य along with, निहत्य having killed, भीमम् fierce, अमित्रनाशनम् killer of foes, यथैव in the same way, बलिनम् , महासुरम् Lord of Devatas, विष्णुर्यथा like Vishnu, वीरशोभाम् like a triumphant hero, अभजत् shone.

40016239.author: Translation
40016239.content: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).

40016240.author: पदार्थः
40016240.content: तदा then, देवगणाः army of Devatas, स्वयम् themselves, रामः Rama, अतिबलः Atibala, लक्ष्मणःच and Lakshmana, तथैव in the same way, सुग्रीवमुखाः Sugriva the chief, प्लवङ्गमाः of monkeys, तथा so also, महाबलः of exceeding might, विभीषणश्चैव Vibheeshana also, कपिम् monkey, अपूजयन् praised.

40016240.author: Translation
40016240.content: Thereafter Rama with the army of Devatas, Atibala and Lakshmana, in the same way Sugriva, the army chief, so also, Vibheeshana of exceeding might praised Hanuman. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
